tactics:
induction p with
  | nil => simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
  | cons kv p ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, v⟩ := kv
    simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
    simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote]
    split at h <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.fixedVar] <;> omega
induction p <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote] <;> split at h <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.fixedVar] <;> omega
revert h; induction p <;> simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote] <;> omega
